summary: Unescaped inner pipes in ` ※<|im_end|>` in the new #906 evidence-index table row (docs/marker_training_recipe.md:338) split the GFM cell and truncate the row's rendered content
evidence: docs/marker_training_recipe.md:338, introduced by round commit 03018794f1fa (git show confirms the +1 line). Convention: .claude/rules/analyzer-section-reference.md:453 — 'MDX safety also requires escaping inner pipes in table-cell tokens ... Escape the inner pipes and wrap in backticks' (incident #399); GFM treats a pipe as a cell delimiter even inside code spans, and cells beyond the 3-column header are dropped, so everything after the first inner pipe ('im_end|> tail) and right-truncation cut the loss slot mid-train; fixed by ...') is lost from the rendered row. Escaped precedents in sibling docs tables: docs/methodology/issue_558.md:77, issue_810.md:33-44, issue_634.md:30, issue_825.md:18 all write <\|im_end\|>. Fix: escape both pipes in the cell token. Plan.md:127 prescribed the row verbatim unescaped — plan-verbatim does not override the binding convention.
